name: What is the difference between interior and exterior log home sealing?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between interior and exterior log home sealing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior log home sealing involves applying protective clear topcoats, breathable sealers, or interior chinking along gaps between log courses. Exterior sealing focuses on shielding logs from intense UV rays, driving rain, and exterior pests. In contrast, interior sealing is designed to stabilize indoor moisture, stop interior drafts, lock out household dust, and protect the bare timber from stains, hand oils, and smoke without off-gassing harsh odors. When planning interior work, owners often choose low-VOC clear finishes or specialized acrylic chinking that allows interior logs to expand and contract smoothly across changing indoor humidity levels.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interior sealing focuses on draft control, dust prevention, and wood protection using low-VOC finishes, while exterior sealing guards against sun, driving rain, and weather exposure.
